fusions.name: Bitterleaf Nibble
fusions.desc: A quick nibble that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dregs Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a bitter pellet that deals 16 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Run It Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweat It Out
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
